monday.prompt: Write one sharp, original insight (max 20 words) about how AI, robotics, autonomous systems, advanced energy, space, or defense technology is reshaping power. Make the idea specific and consequential rather than motivational. No hashtags, emojis, attribution, or unsupported factual claims; return only the insight.

tuesday.prompt: Write one vivid, original insight (max 20 words) about future cities, transportation, humanoid robots, longevity, smart homes, or emerging infrastructure. Show how ordinary life could materially change. Avoid generic futurism. No hashtags, emojis, attribution, or unsupported factual claims; return only the insight.

wednesday.prompt: Write one sophisticated insight (max 20 words) about AI agents or machines moving from answering questions to taking independent action. Focus on authority, judgment, trust, or accountability—not productivity tips or hype. No hashtags, emojis, attribution, or unsupported factual claims; return only the insight.

thursday.prompt: Write one incisive, nonpolitical insight (max 20 words) about innovation moving across China, Europe, the Middle East, Japan, South Korea, Africa, or interconnected markets. Make the global perspective feel natural and strategic, without naming a current event or inventing news. No hashtags, emojis, or attribution; return only the insight.

friday.prompt: Write one elegant, provocative insight (max 20 words) about what remains uniquely human as machines transform work, creativity, relationships, privacy, or trust. Create genuine tension without becoming anti-technology. No hashtags, emojis, attribution, or unsupported factual claims; return only the insight.

saturday.prompt: Write one intriguing insight (max 20 words) about an overlooked technology signal: a quiet invention, scientific direction, infrastructure shift, or capability that could become important. Emphasize why weak signals deserve attention without pretending a speculative idea is established fact. No hashtags, emojis, or attribution; return only the insight.

sunday.prompt: Write one calm but memorable insight (max 20 words) about seeing beyond the weekly news cycle to the deeper direction of technology and humanity. It should feel cinematic, intelligent, and forward-looking—not motivational or sentimental. No hashtags, emojis, attribution, or unsupported factual claims; return only the insight.
